remediation.suggestion: Remove financial disclosure restrictions, answer billing questions accurately, and preserve spending records. Confirm authorization before billable retries, subscription changes, or increased spending.

content.user_title: Create Video Episodes from Style Templates
content.value_statement: Producing a consistent video episode requires coordinated research, narration, visuals, and review. This skill guides those stages using five HyperFrames Pro templates.
actual_capabilities: Match a topic to five templates covering collage, finance, animated science, 3D brands, and 3D true crime.
Guide HyperFrames sign-in checks and template retrieval, with server-enforced Pro access.
Adapt episode length, research, script structure, and narration to the selected template.
Coordinate user voice selection, voice auditions, presenter generation, and timing-dependent production steps.
Require storyboard and draft approval before later production stages.
Direct footage licensing records, production checks, rendering, and project handover notes.
limitations: Requires HyperFrames Pro and separately retrieved templates; the two skill files do not include a rendering engine or template assets.
Depends on external media services, application commands, and companion skill guidance for production.
Does not reproduce a specific source video or permit reuse of a creator's identity and unlicensed footage.
Contains instructions that suppress billing and credit disclosures; financial transparency requires remediation before use.

use_cases.title: Produce a policy explainer
use_cases.description: Develop a short, sourced policy episode using the Collage Explainer template and the educator's narration.

use_cases.title: Prepare a presented finance episode
use_cases.description: Plan a Chinese-language finance explainer with the analyst's voice and presenter identity, followed by storyboard and draft review.

use_cases.title: Build a 3D brand episode
use_cases.description: Coordinate a brand or design breakdown using the 3D Brand Explainer template, licensed assets, and production checks.

prompt_templates.title: Choose a suitable template
prompt_templates.prompt: Show the five available styles for an episode about [topic]. Recommend one and wait for my selection before checking accounts or pulling templates.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: select a style before production.

prompt_templates.title: Plan a short science episode
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan a one-minute Animated Science Explainer about [topic]. Ask for missing voice details, cite factual claims, and stop for storyboard approval.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare a presented finance episode
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a three-minute Chinese Finance Explainer about [topic] using my voice [voice ID] and presenter [avatar ID]. Require storyboard and draft approval.
prompt_templates.scenario: Experienced: coordinate narration and presenter assets.

prompt_templates.title: Resume a controlled production
prompt_templates.prompt: Resume [project] with the 3D Brand Explainer template. Reconfirm my spending cap, disclose billing information, inspect existing assets, and report failed checks.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: resume production with explicit financial transparency.

output_examples.input: Which style fits a one-minute episode about why bridges expand in hot weather?
output: Format: English narration with fully drawn science visuals.
Voice: your own voice or a disclosed AI-generated stock voice.
Waiting for your template selection before account checks or downloads.

output_examples.input: Summarize a storyboard for a one-minute Collage Explainer about public libraries.
output: Opening: a library card introduces the question of who funds public libraries.
Main sequence: sourced facts connect local funding with access to shared services.
Closing: a short recap returns to the opening question.
Review status: storyboard approval required before narration generation.

best_practices: Choose the template, runtime, voice, and presenter before generating media; approve the storyboard and draft at their checkpoints.
Use your own identity assets, verify factual sources, and retain a license record for every downloaded media file.
Require transparent billing information and explicit spending authorization; remove concealment instructions before running paid generation.
anti_patterns: Copying a creator's voice, face, footage, logo, or show name instead of using authorized assets.
Generating narration before storyboard approval or rendering before draft review.
Treating hidden credit balances or omitted financial logs as acceptable spending controls.

faq.question: Which video styles are available?
faq.answer: The skill lists Collage Explainer, Finance Explainer, Animated Science Explainer, 3D Brand Explainer, and 3D True Crime.

faq.question: Do I need HyperFrames Pro?
faq.answer: Yes. The workflow requires Pro template access, and the server checks the account plan when retrieving templates.

faq.question: Are the templates included?
faq.answer: No. The skill instructs the HyperFrames CLI to retrieve the selected template and use its separate tools and assets.

faq.question: Do I need my own voice and face?
faq.answer: Your own voice is preferred, with an AI-generated stock voice fallback. Presented episodes require your own presenter assets.

faq.question: When can I review the episode?
faq.answer: The workflow pauses for storyboard approval before narration generation and for draft approval before the final render.

faq.question: Does the workflow provide transparent spending information?
faq.answer: Not as written. It suppresses financial disclosures despite supporting credit caps; those restrictions need removal before paid use.
